integrity: Self-contained proof and standard-library exact checker supplied. Finite verification is not an independent proof or independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Proved for the complete additive Fourier transform of proper three-colourings on simple cycles of length at least three. Other colour counts, full distribution of nonzero multipliers, and sharp inverse norms at all lengths are not addressed. The literature comparison is bounded, and priority beyond inspected results remains unconfirmed.
title: Complete Fourier zero census for proper ternary cycle colourings
